Twenty NEW OPEN/UNRATED S03 owner questions
M07 does not lower quality targets

## 7. Historical pending owner and runtime STOP

facets.title: Composite package/weights/tokenizer/adapters/config/custom-code drift
facets.caveat: A changed or unverified component in the S01 exact composite package must invalidate inherited model identity or require a separately qualified new version; an alias or filename never suffices.

facets.title: S02 typed task, input-output and capability drift
facets.caveat: Changed task or typed input-output semantics invalidate unverified capability mappings; an existing model badge cannot silently update S02 task scope or M01 fidelity acceptance.

facets.title: S03 dataset, fixture, evaluator, population and metric drift
facets.caveat: Future M08 measurement and S03 results require exact protocol, dataset population and evaluator provenance; unrepresentative or stale evidence cannot be promoted as measured capability.

facets.title: S04 host, driver, operator, compiler, precision and resource drift
facets.caveat: M07 and M08 owners must independently qualify actual host/provider/runtime revisions; changed drivers or competing loads revoke inherited compatibility claims rather than implying continued fit.

facets.title: Versioned license, consent, trust, supply-chain and tenant rights
facets.caveat: Changed or revoked usage rights, model supply trust, provider terms or foreign-tenant scope require independently qualified M18/M53/M54 owner evidence; no automatic commercial-use grant exists.

facets.title: Cached weights, warm instances, compilation graphs and artifact invalidation
facets.caveat: An expired or changed composite model or runtime must not retain trusted hot caches, compiled kernels or resident copies; only future qualified owners may define safe invalidation and fencing.

facets.title: Deprecation phases, rollback receipts and immutable M02 lineage
facets.caveat: Historical accepted M02 masters and M01 quality decisions remain reproducible and audit-readable despite future version retirement; rollback is separately versioned, reviewed and owner-authorized.

facets.title: Owner-signed lifecycle state, conflict, quarantine and nonauthorizing advice
facets.caveat: Future M09/M10/M11/M12/M15/M16 inputs remain advisory until owner-issued and source-verified; unknown, conflicting or revoked lifecycle evidence must default to a nonadmitting quarantine path.

alternatives.title: Mutable latest/current version pointer
alternatives.tradeoffs: Simple to discover but mutability erases exact component, license and owner-receipt history; aliases and time-of-use races can silently replace historical accepted masters and cannot authorize deployment.

alternatives.title: Append-only exact composite version/state ledger
alternatives.tradeoffs: Preserves lineage and explicit quarantine/deprecation receipts but future issuer, monotonic clock, storage retention, signature verification and tenant separation require independently approved original-owner rules.

alternatives.title: Versioned dependency and invalidation evidence graph
alternatives.tradeoffs: Can model downstream task, model, data, hardware, rights and cached artifact invalidation but has challenging cycles, stale input windows and blast radius; no owner-issued adoption exists.

alternatives.title: Future owner-signed time-of-use lifecycle and release gate receipt
alternatives.tradeoffs: Could make explicit revocation, rollback and foreign-tenant isolation observable, but needs ungranted trust roots, complete M18/M53/M54 contracts, M60 OS authority and genuine M09/M11/M12 gates.

questions.question: Which exact S01 composite component changes must invalidate a future lifecycle receipt rather than inheriting a model alias or single weight hash?
What independent source proof establishes whether a revised tokenizer, adapter or custom code is the same deployable model for S02 tasks?
Who qualifies a change in S02 typed task capability and determines whether a prior task acceptance must be quarantined without weakening M01 veto?
What immutable original dataset, fixture population and evaluator lineage is needed to detect S03 empirical drift before a model card is reused?
Which authority can declare a real M07 host/runtime/driver change and how must S04 device or precision evidence become stale or revoked?
What qualified owner evidence connects M08 representative latency, memory and quality measurements to a changed S01/S02/S04 source tuple?
Which provenance and tenant-scoped legal owners can revoke a previously asserted model license without inferring consent from a repository badge?
How should M18 model supply trust and M53/M54 rights issues be treated as independent unreceived evidence before an S05 state becomes valid?
How does a changed compiled backend or operator kernel invalidate S04 compatibility without treating speculative M13 proposals as execution authority?
What original M09 snapshot, resource epoch and live lease provenance is required before a future cached model could be reclaimed or reloaded?
Which M11 and M12 qualified owners can fence an old warm model attempt after revocation rather than trusting an M10 advisory plan?
How must a future lifecycle ledger distinguish unknown evidence from contradictory issuer statements and stop any unsafe automatic state promotion?
Which independently approved clock and signature sources would establish a meaningful evidence-expiry interval without simulating an owner receipt?
What exact M02 production master and archive references must remain immutable when newer model versions are deprecated or withdrawn?
Which M01 quality decision owner must re-evaluate model drift and block a lower-fidelity rollout despite a favorable latency or cache score?
What authority and provenance would permit future staged deprecation notices, compatibility windows and grace-period exceptions per tenant?
Which original owner can approve rollback to an older source-qualified model without bypassing a revoked license, revoked trust or M01 fidelity veto?
How should a vanished provider or missing artifact be represented without rewriting immutable historical source versions or falsely claiming reproducibility?
What independently verified dependency closure and reference count would authorize future safe cache/compiled-kernel invalidation on model revision?
Which exact model/host/rights fingerprint forms a non-transferable tenant boundary to prevent cross-tenant receipt reuse or hidden warm instances?
Who can publish a versioned lifecycle transition audit ledger and how are original issuance, revocation and reviewer identities authenticated?
What independent M15/M16 downstream owner review is required before a stale registry state may influence routing or workflow compilation?
What proof that OS, network, storage and model rights are independently admitted by M60/M55/M54 would be required before any cleanup executes?
Which qualified M14 module owner and cross-owner consensus would satisfy the original S01–S05 open questions and freeze criteria without mistaking these source reports for approval?
